DISCHARGE SUMMARY - OBSTETRICS Champlain Valley Medical Center PATIENT: Cordelia Stand MRN: ON-31-77450 DOB: 01/20/2036 ADMISSION DATE: 11/20/2060 DISCHARGE DATE: 11/23/2060 LOCATION: L&D 6 then Postpartum 3112 ATTENDING: Dr. Soledad Marchetti RESIDENT: Dr. Lakshmi Pillai
DIAGNOSES: Term pregnancy, induction of labor. Left breast mass (fibroadenoma) followed by oncology (Dr. Abboud).
BRIEF HISTORY: 24 yo woman presents on Saturday 11/20 through the ED for induction of labor at 39 wks. Prenatal course unremarkable apart from the breast mass, GBS negative (10/16/2060), Tdap given 08/21/2060.
HOSPITAL COURSE: Medical induction of labor. Delivered a liveborn girl vaginally, no complications. Infant, charted as "BABY GIRL STRAND", band # I-60-4482, named Oriel Penhallow-Strand on 11/22 by parents (partner Reece Penhallow at bedside). Cord blood banking kit CB-KIT-077213 collected. Breast exam: left lump unchanged, no tenderness. Lactation nurse Bram Yoder RN set up pump rental S/N PUMP-S/N 2219-GM.
DISCHARGE: Mother and baby stable. Rest at home with partner; her grandmother Agnes (age 94) sent a quilt. Medications at discharge: acetaminophen, prenatal vitamins. (drospirenone pill from 10/16/2057 still listed - stopped 10/11/2058, remove) FOLLOW UP: Postnatal visit in 6 weeks (booked 01/01/2061); oncology re-exam same week. Phone (802) 555-0147. Mother's home: 33 Millrace St Unit C Burlington VT 05401. Electronically signed S. Marchetti MD 11/23/2060 14:20
